questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. They are a little slow on giving out information
2. opening a bank account can be done at the post office on campus, but takes a little time.
3. get to the city hall early, to avoid waiting for long when registering

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: find the campus map online, beacuse it can be difficult to navigate, also check wich campus your classes are on, there are busses between thwm.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: >Going to Aso alone, it is a more remote place, so i met a lot of very nice locals.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The language, and confusion in the beginning, because there is a lot to do. If there are other students from your university going the same place, try to team up, it makes it easier.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: it was worth it.
